theme: release relpath STRIPPREFIX STRIPCOMMON SAMPLEK smoke checklist

tests.name: single_stripcommon_empty
tests.cmd: one path → REL empty pre=full path

tests.name: sample_empty_k0

tests.name: drop_has_unknown

weaknesses.title: STRIPCOMMON LCP is character-level mid-segment
weaknesses.detail: Peers state/peer_a|b|c strip to pre=state/peer_ leaving a/plate.json. Want dirname-boundary strip (state/) or segment-aware RELPATHS. Same class as COMMONPREFIX path gap.

weaknesses.title: Single-field STRIPCOMMON empties the relative key
weaknesses.detail: One absolute path → LCP is whole field → REL becomes empty string while STRIPCOMMON_PRE is the full path and STRIPCOMMON_HIT=1. Agents treat success as usable relative inventory.

weaknesses.title: STRIPPREFIX partial hit leaves absolute orphans in REL bag
weaknesses.detail: Mixed /opt/rel/* + /var/other/x after strip root keeps /var/other/x absolute. No STRICT mode requiring all fields match; agents must check STRIPPREFIX_HIT == LINES.

weaknesses.title: SAMPLEK non-deterministic without CUBALC_SEED
weaknesses.detail: Smoke plates change across runs unless host sets CUBALC_SEED. No in-program SAMPLEK seed arg; ops agents forget ENV contract.

weaknesses.title: Slash-only STRIPCOMMON still strips and HIT counts
weaknesses.detail: STRIPCOMMON_PRE='/' non-blank so BLANK checks pass; program must EQS pre '/'. Same false-useful-root class as path_root_board.

weaknesses.title: WRITE omits final trailing newline
weaknesses.detail: cat -A last ABS/REL/SMOKE line without $. Stable plate hygiene issue.

weaknesses.title: No STRIPPREFIX_STRICT / all-must-match gate
weaknesses.detail: Want hard fail when HIT < N. Agents reimplement with NUM compare every call.

weaknesses.title: STRIPSUFFIX is exact string not extension-aware
weaknesses.detail: Fine for .so peel; no EXTNAME map form. c.s not confused with .so (good) but agents want map-ext strip.

workarounds: EQS STRIPCOMMON_PRE '/' or BLANK REL after single-field strip → treat as no useful rel
If LINES==1 skip STRIPCOMMON or keep basename via BASENAME EACH
Assert STRIPPREFIX_HIT == LINES abs for clean REL
Always export CUBALC_SEED for SAMPLEK smoke plates
Prefer explicit STRIPPREFIX known root over STRIPCOMMON for release trees
loadlines ||| not WORDS for absolute paths
language_gaps: Single-field STRIPCOMMON keep-as-is or basename option
SAMPLEK seed argument (not only CUBALC_SEED ENV)
